title: Transit ingestion: duplicate DB lookup before size limit check
description: transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs:44-68: check_ingest() runs the msgid_map.lookup_by_msgid() DB query (line 45) before checking article_bytes.len() > MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES (line 61). A peer systematically sending 2 MB articles (valid msgid, oversized body) forces one SQLite read per article before rejection. The size check is a CPU-cheap array length comparison; the duplicate check is a DB round-trip. → Reorder: size check first, duplicate check second. The doc-comment at lines 25-26 documents the intended order wrong — fix the comment too.
